text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Vircon32 is an open-source fantasy console designed to recreate the experience of developing games for a fictional 32-bit system. It provides a complete virtual hardware environment with its own CPU, graphics, sound, controllers, and cartridge format. The platform focuses on teaching game development while allowing creators to build original games with a consistent set of limitations inspired by fifth-generation consoles.
